verses.sanskrit:
नारद उवाच।
              शक्रस्य तु सभा दिव्या भास्वरा कर्मनिर्मिता। स्वयं शक्रेण कौरव्य निर्जितार्कसमप्रभा॥१॥
verses.english: Narada said The celestials Sabha of Shakra (Indra) is full of lustre; and it was obtained by him as the fruit of his actions. O descendant of Kuru, it was made by Shakra (Indra) himself as effulgent as the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तीर्णा योजनशतं शतमध्यर्धमायता। वैहायसी कामगमा पञ्चयोजनमुच्छ्रिता॥२॥
verses.english: Its breadth is one hundred Yojanas, its length is also one hundred and fifty Yojanas; it is five Yojanas in height. It can go anywhere at will.
verses.bhavadeepa: शक्रस्येति । कर्मभिर्विश्वकर्मणो यत्नैर्निर्मिता । शक्रेण निर्जिता चेति संबन्धः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: जराशोकक्लमापेता निरातङ्का शिवा शुभा। वेश्मासनवती रम्या दिव्यपादपशोभिता॥३॥
verses.english: It dispels decrepitude, grief, fatigue, and fear; it is beneficial and auspicious, it is furnished with rooms and seats, it is charming and adorned with celestials trees.
verses.bhavadeepa: अध्यर्धं सार्धम् आयता दीर्घा वैहायसी खेचरी ॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां देवेश्वरः पार्थ सभायां परमासने। आस्ते शच्या महेन्द्राण्या श्रिया लक्ष्म्या च भारत॥४॥
verses.english: O son of Pritha, O descendant of Bharata, in that Sabha sits on an excellent seat the lord of the celestialss with his wife Sachi who is the embodiment of beauty and wealth.
verses.bhavadeepa: निरातङ्का निर्भया शिवा शान्तजना शुभा कल्याणावहा ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: बिभ्रद्वपुरनिर्देश्यं किरीटी लोहिताङ्गदः। विरजोम्बरश्चित्रमाल्यो ह्रीकीर्तिद्युतिभिः सह॥५॥
verses.english: With an indescribable vague from, with a crown on his head, with bright bracelets on the upper arms, attired in pure white robes, and adorned with many colored garlands, he sits there with Beauty, Fame and Glory by his side.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामुपासते नित्यं महात्मानं शतक्रतुम्। मरुतः सर्वशो राजन्सर्वे च गृहमेधिनः॥६॥
verses.english: There daily wait upon that illustrious deity of one thousand sacrifices (Indra) all the Marutas that lead the life of house holders,

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धा देवर्षयश्चैव साध्या देवगणास्तथा। मरुत्त्वन्तश्च सहिता भास्वन्तो हेममालिनः॥७॥
verses.english: The Siddhas, the celestials Rishi, the Sadhyas the celestialss, and celestialss, and the bright complexioned Marutas adorned with golden garlands;

verses.sanskrit: एते सानुचराः सर्वे दिव्यरूपाः स्वलङ्कृताः। उपासते महात्मानं देवराजमरिन्दमम्॥८॥
verses.english: These with their followers all possessing celestials forms and adorned with ornaments always wait upon and worship the illustrious chastiser of foes, the lord of the celestialss.

verses.sanskrit: तथा देवर्षयः सर्वे पार्थ शक्रमुपासते। अमला धूतपाप्मानो दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः॥९॥
verses.english: O son of Pritha, there wait upon Shakra (Indra) all the celestials Rishis of pure soul, all as the fire, and all whose sins are completely washed off,

verses.sanskrit: तेजस्विनः सोमसुतो विशोका विगतज्वराः। पराशरः पर्वतश्च तथा सावर्णिगालवौ॥१०॥
verses.english: All that are energetic, without grief of any kind, and without any fever (of anxiety), all performers of performers of Soma sacrifice. Parashara, Parvata, Savarni, Galava.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खश्च लिखितश्चैव तथा गौरशिरा मुनिः। दुर्वासाः क्रोधनः श्येनस्तथा दीर्घतमा मुनिः॥११॥
verses.english: Shankha, Likhita the Rishi Gaurashira, Durvasa, Krodhana, Shyena, the Rishi Dirghatama, Pavitrapani, Savarni, Yajnavalkya, Bhaluki, Uddalka, Svetaketu, Tandya, Bhandayani, Havishman, Garishtha, King Harishchandra, Hridhya, Udarashandilya, Parashara, Krishivala, Vataskandha, Vishakha, Vidhata, Kala, Karaladanta, Tvashta, Vishvakarma, and Tumburu.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रपाणिः सावर्णिर्याज्ञवल्क्योऽथ भालुकिः। उद्दालकः श्वेतकेतुस्ताण्ड्यो भाण्डायनिस्तथा॥१२॥
हविष्मांश्च गरिष्ठश्च हरिश्चन्द्रश्च पार्थिवः। हृद्यश्चोदरशाण्डिल्यः पाराशर्यः कृषीवलः॥१३॥
वातस्कन्धो विशाखश्च विधाता काल एव च। करालदन्तस्त्वष्टा च विश्वकर्मा च तुम्बुरुः॥१४॥
अयोनिजा योनिजाश्च वायुभक्षा हुताशिनः। ईशानं सर्वलोकस्य वज्रिणं समुपासते॥१५॥
verses.english: Some born of women, some not born of women; some living on air, some on fire, (all these Rishis) worship the wielder of thunder (Indra), the lord of all the world. Sahadeva, Sunitha, the greatly ascetic Valmiki, Shamika of truthful speech promise keeping Prachetas, Meghatithi, Vamadeva, Pulastya, Pulaha, and Kratu Marutta, Marichi, greatly ascetic Sthanu Kakshivan, Goutama, Tarkshya, the Rishi Vaishvanara, the Rishi Kalakavrikshiya, Ashravya, Hiranmaya, Samvartta, Devahavya, greatly powerful Vishvaksena, Kanwa, Katyayana, Garga, Kaushika-(all these) and the celestials waters and plants, faith, Intelligence and the goddess of learning,

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवः सुनीथश्च वाल्मीकिश्च महातपाः। समीकः सत्यवाक्चैव प्रचेताः सत्यसङ्गरः॥१६॥
मेधातिथिर्वामदेवः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः। मरुत्तश्च मरीचिश्च स्थाणुश्चात्र महातपाः॥१७॥
कक्षीवान्गौतमस्तार्क्ष्यस्तथा वैश्वानरो मुनिः। मुनिः कालकवृक्षीय आश्राव्योऽथ हिरण्मयः॥१८॥
संवर्तो देवहव्यश्च विष्वक्सेनश्च वीर्यवान्। दिव्या आपस्तथौषध्यः श्रद्धा मेधा सरस्वती॥१९॥
अर्थो धर्मश्च कामश्च विद्युतश्चैव पाण्डव। जलवाहास्तथा मेघा वायवस्तनयित्नवः॥२०॥
verses.english: Dharma, Artha and Kama also lightning, clouds charged with rains, the winds, all the loud-sounding forces of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: प्राची दिग्यज्ञवाहाश्च पावकाः सप्तविंशतिः। अग्नीषोमौ तथेन्द्राग्नी मित्रश्च सविताऽर्यमा॥२१॥
verses.english: The eastern point, the twenty seven fires conveying the sacrificial Ghee, Agni, Soma, the fire of Indra, Mitra, Savitri and Aryama.

verses.sanskrit: भगो विश्वे च साध्याश्च गुरुः शुक्रस्तथैव च। विश्वावसुश्चित्रसेनः सुमनस्तरुणस्तथा॥२२॥
verses.english: Bhaga, Vishva, the Sadhyas, the preceptor (Brihaspati), Shukra, Vishvavasu, Chitrasena, Sumana, Taruna.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञाश्च दक्षिणाश्चैवं ग्रहास्तोभाश्च भारत। यज्ञवाहाश्च ये मन्त्राः सर्वे तत्र समासते॥२३॥
verses.english: The sacrificial Dakshinas (gifts to Brahmanas), the planets, the starts, the Mantras which are uttered in sacrifices, O descendant of Bharata, all these are present there.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवाप्सरसो राजन्गन्धर्वाश्च मनोरमाः। नृत्यवादित्रगीतैश्च हास्यैश्च विविधैरपि॥२४॥
verses.english: O king, many charming Apsaras and Gandharvas gratify there the lord of the celestialss, Shatakratu, (Indra) with their various kinds of dances and vocal and instrumental music, with the practice of auspicious rites, and with the exhibition of many skillful feats. They gratify there the illustrious slayer of Vitra and Vala with their various skill. The Brahmana Rishis, all the royal and celestials sages,

verses.sanskrit: रमयन्ति स्म नृपते देवराजं शतक्रतुम्। स्तुतिभिर्मङ्गलैश्चैव वस्तुवन्तः कर्मभिस्तथा॥२५॥
विक्रमैश्च महात्मानं बलवृत्रनिषूदनम्। ब्रह्मराजर्षयश्चैव सर्वे देवर्षयस्तथा॥२६॥
विमानैर्विविधैर्दिव्यैर्दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः। स्रग्विणो भूषिताः सर्वे यान्ति चायान्ति चापरे॥२७॥
verses.english: As effulgent as fire, adorned with garlands and ornaments often come to and go from that celestials assembly-hall riding on various kinds of celestials cars.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतिश्च शुक्रश्च नित्यमास्तां हि तत्र वै। एते चान्ये च बहवो महात्मानो यतव्रताः॥२८॥
verses.english: Brihaspati and Shukra are always present there on the occasions. These and many other illustrious Rishis of rigid vows.

verses.sanskrit: विमानैश्चन्द्रसङ्काशैः सोमवत्प्रियदर्शनाः। ब्रह्मणः सदृशा राजन्भृगुः सप्तर्षयस्तथा॥२९॥
verses.english: O king, Bhrigu and the seven Rishis who are equal to Brahma himself, use always to come to and go from that assembly-hall, riding on cars as beautiful as the car of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: एषा सभा मया राजन्दृष्टा पुष्करमालिनी। शतक्रतोर्महाबाहो याम्यामपि सभां शृणु॥३०॥
verses.english: O king, I have seen this Sabha, named Pushkaramalini of the deity of one thousand sacrifices (Indra). Here about the assembly-hall of Yama. now
